digest.component_or_area: pytest fixture and temporary directory management
propositions: Executing nested pytest children in test_engine_dir.py and test_scripts_import_convention.py allocate the user-global numbered temp root without an explicit --basetemp and inadvertently delete cleanup-eligible trees from unrelated runs during session finish.

Parent pytest processes must pass a unique child-specific --basetemp (e.g., tmp_path/mixed-module-pytest or tmp_path/standalone-pytest) to each executing nested subprocess to isolate temporary lifetimes and prevent cross-run cleanup collisions.

TempPathFactory.getbasetemp in pytest 9.1.1 creates and registers cleanup for the numbered root; pytest_sessionfinish skips cleanup only when _basetemp remains None, so executing children that resolve fixtures are vulnerable.
Collect-only nested pytest children and pytester-managed launches remain safe because they either never allocate TempPathFactory._basetemp or the helper already injects an explicit basetemp.
